verdicts.reason: Neither is ready to ship. A keeps the original pill shapes, but its left edges don't line up: SOLSTICE starts at about x110, the headline at about x88 and the pills at about x105–108. The CTA floats off to the right with no shared edge, Honey Rosemary is orphaned in the bottom-left, and the large yellow circles sit busily behind the headline. B has a cleaner shared left edge (about x47) for the brand name, headline and subhead, but its pills and button no longer match the original. The button has become a squarer rounded rectangle and the pills have lost their rounded ends. The pill row doesn't line up with the text margin and Honey Rosemary is centred under the other two, and the pink circle runs under the Cucumber Mint pill. Both leave a large empty area to the left of the CTA.
